title: Hull C (MISC, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Hull C is a heavy freighter from MISC in Star Citizen with a crew of four. The bridge sits at the front, ahead of a long spine (spindle) that holds the cargo outside the hull. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: Hull C: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Hull C's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Cargo spindle (4608 SCU)
controls.text: Cargo boxes for 4608 SCU are fixed outside the hull on a long spindle that can grow longer.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Hull C: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Hull C besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Crew (four)
controls.text: The Hull C is flown by a crew of four. More people on board can share the work.
controls.context: A second person on board can take over jobs such as turrets, scanning or the radio, so the pilot can concentrate on flying.
